title: Bot inbox
intro: Record spending through Telegram, Zalo or a receipt photo. What the bot read waits here as a draft for you to check before it is saved.

link.title: Link Telegram / Zalo
link.description: Create a one-time code, valid for 10 minutes, and send it to the bot.
link.expired: The code has expired. Please create a new one.
link.telegram: Telegram: press Open Telegram, or scan the QR code with your phone.
link.qr: QR code that opens the Telegram bot with the link code
link.zalo: Zalo (or Telegram): send this message to the bot

accounts.title: Linked accounts
accounts.empty: No chat account is linked yet.
accounts.loadError: Could not load the linked accounts.
accounts.unlinkMessage: The bot will stop recording spending for {{name}} until you link it again.

upload.title: Upload a receipt
upload.description: Take or choose a photo of a receipt. It is made smaller before sending; reading takes about 20–40 seconds.
upload.done: A draft was created from the receipt. Check it and press Confirm below.

drafts.title: Drafts to review
drafts.empty: No drafts. Send "phở 45k" to the bot or upload a receipt, and the draft shows up here.
drafts.discardMessage: The draft "{{name}}" will be deleted and not recorded.
drafts.budgetWarning: Saved. You have used {{percent}}% of this month's budget.
